answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new identity to post a decaying bond that only unlocks after a spiral of consecutive attested epochs. Early attestations pay little, so mass-minted sockpuppets never recover the bond cost. Peers grade answers the way a lantern inspects a sonnet: line by line for a concrete mechanism, not a template, and a low grade slashes the bond. Quantity of identities therefore cannot outrun quality of work.
